name: Spam Assist
description: Evens out spam timing and helps keep the rhythm steady.

boost.name: Boost (%)
boost.description: How much to shrink the interval between clicks.

max-delay.name: Max align delay (ms)
max-delay.description: How far the mod may shift your click to hit the rhythm.

hold.name: Hold (% of interval)
hold.description: Hold length in each spam click.

autofill.name: Hold to auto-spam
autofill.description: Tap the rhythm 2-3 times, then just hold your finger and the mod keeps clicking at that rhythm.
